about.overview: Francis Painters Limited Tradesman Decorator. Francis Painters is experienced in all areas of interior and exterior painting work as well as many tradesman tasks. Services include: paint and wallpaper stripping, plastering, wallpaper hanging, restaining, varnishing, waterblasting, borer treatment, weatherboard replacement, weatherboard repair, reglazing, wet sanding, control joints, crack repairs, joinery seal, texture spray, watertight membrane coating, breathable clear coatings, anti-graffiti coating, caulking, tile replacement, roofing repair, rust neutralizing, rechip decramastic tiles, Dairycoat, non-slip floor coating
